items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Teddy Wilson and Keg Gag, my brother, Mel Hinton, all of us, we'd go out to all of the after hour joints and whatnot and blow.

ctx.x: -- around and jam all the time. Sometimes Art Tatum would come in town, and we'd -- Teddy Wilson and Keg Gag, my brother, Mel Hinton, all of us, we'd go out to all of the after hour joints and whatnot and blow. And Chu Berry was blowing so much horn, man.
Explain his style of playing, Budd.
